instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY .js / .jsx extensions. Do not use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Bridge CSS variables to Three.js: use a utility or hook to read getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--primary') and pass it to <meshStandardMaterial color={...} />.
Strictly avoid cliché casino aesthetics. No green felt. No blinking neon. Stick to the minimal-luxe Scandi-Noir direction.

aesthetic_direction.description: A moody, high-end, and deeply atmospheric take on casino gaming. Bypasses the cliché green felt, neon lights, and gaudy gold. Instead, it leverages dark architectural slate, frosted glass panels (crystal glassmorphism), and sharp 1px borders. The interface feels like an exclusive VIP room in a modern Nordic hotel.
core_principles: Texture over Gloss: Matte 3D surfaces and moody lighting.
High Contrast Lighting: 3D scenes must use stark, directional cinematic lighting to cast dramatic shadows.
Architectural UI: Sharp corners mixed with 8px radii. Use pure 1px white/10 borders.

headings.usage: Landing page hero, Dashboard primary titles, In-game big win banners.

body.usage: UI labels, player data, operator dashboard tables.

mono.usage: Player balance, bet amounts, activity log timestamps.

color_tokens.strategy: CSS Variables applied to `:root`. R3F must read these to color 3D meshes.

spacing_and_layout.scale: Generous Tailwind Scale. Use p-8 and p-12 for containers.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_lobby: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8. Four massive bento cards for the games.
spacing_and_layout.control_room_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Density-focused for operator. Side nav col-span-2. Main content col-span-10.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' for over-game UI. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10`. Must not look muddy.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp grid borders `border-border` to expose the skeleton.

components.operator_sidebar: Glassmorphic left sidebar. Clean lines, text-muted turning text-white on hover.
components.bento_game_card: Relative positioning, overflow hidden. Hover scales background image. Gradient overlay bottom-to-top for text legibility. 1px border.
components.in_game_ui_hud: Floating bento pieces over the 3D scene. Balance pill top right. Bet controls bottom center.
components.casino_chips: 3D meshes in R3F. Minimalist discs, matte finish, edge stripes mapping to `--primary`.
components.3d_table_surface: Three.js PlaneGeometry. `MeshStandardMaterial` with roughness 0.9. Color maps to `--surface` or `--bg`.

layouts.public_landing: Split screen. Left: immersive dark architecture image. Right: Login forms (Tabs: Player/Operator).
layouts.operator_dashboard: Control Room Grid. Sidebar + Dense Data Tables + Theme Live Preview.
layouts.player_lobby: Top nav (Logo + Balance). Main area: 4 large bento tiles for Blackjack, Baccarat, Pikapokeri (Video Poker), Casino War.
layouts.in_game: Absolute full-width/height R3F Canvas `z-0`. UI HUD layered on top `z-10`.

hero_background.description: Dark moody abstract architecture for public landing hero.

lobby_tiles.usage: Base texture for game tiles in the lobby.

table_texture.usage: Use as color map or bump map for the R3F table surface if needed, otherwise use solid css vars.

motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight scale-up using Framer Motion.
motion.3d_animations: Cards dealing must use smooth bezier curves. Camera moves slightly based on mouse position (parallax) for immersion.
